questions.title: Difference and Product
questions.description:
Practise returning computed values from two static methods. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static methods:

    static int difference(int a, int b)
    static int product(int a, int b)

difference must return a - b and product must return a * b.

Input Format:
One line with two integers A and B.

Output Format:
One line with A - B, then A * B, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= A, B <= 100
questions.topic: Introduction to DSA and Java Setup

questions.title: Average of Three Numbers
questions.description:
Return a floating-point average from integer inputs. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double averageThree(int a, int b, int c)

It must return (a + b + c) / 3.0. The harness prints the result rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with three integer marks A, B and C.

Output Format:
One line with the average rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= A, B, C <= 100
questions.topic: Introduction to DSA and Java Setup

questions.title: Simple Interest Calculator
questions.description:
Compute simple interest with the classic formula. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double simpleInterest(double p, double r, int t)

It must return (p * r * t) / 100. The harness prints the value rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with the principal P, the annual rate R and the time T in years.

Output Format:
One line with the simple interest rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= P <= 1000000, 0.1 <= R <= 20.0, 1 <= T <= 30

questions.title: Quotient and Remainder
questions.description:
Use the integer division and remainder operators. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static methods:

    static int quotient(int a, int b)
    static int remainder(int a, int b)

quotient must return a / b and remainder must return a % b.

Input Format:
One line with two integers A and B (B is never zero).

Output Format:
One line with A / B, then A % B, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= B <= A <= 10000
questions.topic: Introduction to DSA and Java Setup

questions.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
questions.description:
Convert a temperature with a floating-point method. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double celsiusToFahrenheit(double c)

It must return F where F = C * 9 / 5 + 32. The harness prints the result rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with a real number C.

Output Format:
One line with the Fahrenheit value rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
-100.0 <= C <= 100.0
questions.topic: Introduction to DSA and Java Setup

questions.title: Rectangle Area and Perimeter
questions.description:
A geometry homework app checks both measurements of a rectangle at once. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static methods:

    static int rectangleArea(int length, int width)
    static int rectanglePerimeter(int length, int width)

rectangleArea must return length * width and rectanglePerimeter must return 2 * (length + width).

Input Format:
One line with the length and the width.

Output Format:
One line with the area, then the perimeter, space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= length, width <= 1000

questions.title: Grocery Receipt Total
questions.description:
A small shop prints taxed line totals for its receipts. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double receiptTotal(double price, int qty, double taxPercent)

It must return the line total: price * qty, increased by taxPercent percent. The harness prints the value rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with the unit price, the quantity and the tax percent.

Output Format:
One line with the taxed total rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
0.5 <= price <= 10000.0, 1 <= qty <= 500, 0 <= taxPercent <= 30.0

questions.title: Cinema Ticket Cost
questions.description:
A cinema charges 150 rupees per adult ticket and 80 rupees per child ticket. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int ticketCost(int adults, int children)

It must return adults * 150 + children * 80.

Input Format:
One line with two integers: the number of adults and the number of children.

Output Format:
One line with the total cost in rupees.

Constraints:
0 <= adults, children <= 50, adults + children >= 1

questions.title: Hostel Mess Bill
questions.description:
A hostel bills Veg meals at 60 rupees and Non-Veg meals at 95 rupees per day. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int messBill(int vegDays, int nonvegDays)

It must return vegDays * 60 + nonvegDays * 95.

Input Format:
One line with two integers: veg days and non-veg days.

Output Format:
One line with the total mess bill.

Constraints:
0 <= vegDays, nonvegDays <= 31

questions.title: Swap the Pair In Place
questions.description:
Two lab partners exchange seats in a two-seat lab row. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void swap(int[] pair)

Arrays in Java are reference objects, so the method can change the caller's data: swap pair[0] and pair[1] IN PLACE. The method returns nothing — do not use return; the harness prints the swapped pair for you.

Input Format:
One line with the two seat numbers.

Output Format:
One line with the pair after swapping, space-separated.

Constraints:
0 <= pair[0], pair[1] <= 100000

questions.title: Group Ticket Discount
questions.description:
A tour operator sells base tickets at B rupees each. Groups of 5 or more people get a 10 percent discount applied with integer maths (subtract total / 10). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int groupFare(int people, int baseFare)

It must return people * baseFare, reduced by total / 10 when people >= 5.

Input Format:
One line with the number of people and the base fare.

Output Format:
One line with the total fare in rupees.

Constraints:
1 <= people <= 100, 50 <= baseFare <= 5000

questions.title: Grade Classifier
questions.description:
A university portal maps marks to letter grades: 90 and above is 'A', 75-89 is 'B', 60-74 is 'C', 40-59 is 'D', and below 40 is 'F'. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static char grade(int marks)

It must return the letter grade character for the marks.

Input Format:
One line with the marks.

Output Format:
One line with the letter grade.

Constraints:
0 <= marks <= 100

questions.title: Sum of Two Integers
questions.description:
Write and run your first Java method. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int sumTwo(int a, int b)

It must return the sum of a and b.

Input Format:
One line with two integers A and B.

Output Format:
One line with A + B.

Constraints:
-1000 <= A, B <= 1000

questions.title: Electricity Bill Slab
questions.description:
A power company charges by slab: the first 100 units cost 3.50 rupees each, the next 100 units cost 5.00 rupees each, and every unit beyond that costs 8.00 rupees. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double electricityBill(int units)

It must return the bill amount for the given units using the three slabs. The harness prints the value rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with the consumed units.

Output Format:
One line with the bill rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= units <= 10000

questions.title: Parking Lot Charge
questions.description:
A mall parking lot charges a flat 30 rupees for the first hour (or part of it) and 15 rupees for every additional STARTED hour. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int parkingCharge(int minutes)

It must return the charge: 30 when minutes <= 60, otherwise 30 plus 15 for each completed-or-started hour beyond the first. Compute the extra hours with integer arithmetic: (minutes - 60 + 59) / 60.

Input Format:
One line with the parked minutes.

Output Format:
One line with the parking charge in rupees.

Constraints:
1 <= minutes <= 1440
questions.topic: Introduction to DSA and Java Setup

questions.title: Fuel Cost per Kilometre
questions.description:
A logistics app reports the fuel cost of a trip per kilometre: total fuel cost is litres * pricePerLitre, and the cost per kilometre divides that by the trip distance. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double costPerKm(double km, double litres, double pricePerLitre)

It must return (litres * pricePerLitre) / km. The harness prints the value rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with the distance in km, the litres used and the price per litre.

Output Format:
One line with the cost per kilometre rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
1 <= km <= 5000, 1 <= litres <= 200, 50 <= pricePerLitre <= 200

questions.title: Gym Membership Plan
questions.description:
A gym charges 500 rupees per month. The personal-trainer add-on costs an extra 200 rupees per month when selected. Members who subscribe for 6 or more months get a 10 percent discount on the final amount (integer maths: subtract total / 10). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int membershipCost(int months, int trainer)

trainer is 1 when the add-on is selected and 0 otherwise.

Input Format:
One line with the number of months and the trainer flag (0 or 1).

Output Format:
One line with the final membership cost in rupees.

Constraints:
1 <= months <= 36, trainer is 0 or 1

questions.title: Triangle Type
questions.description:
A geometry tool first validates a triangle, then classifies it. The sides are valid when all are positive AND every side is smaller than the sum of the other two. Valid triangles are EQUILATERAL (all sides equal), ISOSCELES (exactly two sides equal) or SCALENE (no equal sides). The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static String triangleType(int a, int b, int c)

It must return "INVALID", "EQUILATERAL", "ISOSCELES" or "SCALENE".

Input Format:
One line with the three side lengths.

Output Format:
One line with the classification word.

Constraints:
1 <= a, b, c <= 1000

questions.title: Tiered Taxi Fare
questions.description:
A city taxi meters fares in tiers: the first 2 km cost a flat 50 rupees; every COMPLETED kilometre beyond that costs 18 rupees more; a 20 percent night surcharge (multiply by 1.2) applies when the night flag is set. Rides of 0 km or less cost nothing. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static double taxiFare(double km, int night)

It must return the fare: 0 when km <= 0; otherwise 50 + (int)(km - 2) * 18 when km > 2 (the cast floors the extra km), else 50; multiply the total by 1.2 when night is 1. The harness prints the fare rounded to 2 decimals.

Input Format:
One line with the distance and the night flag (0 or 1).

Output Format:
One line with the fare rounded to 2 decimals.

Constraints:
0 <= km <= 500, night is 0 or 1

questions.title: Shipping Cost Calculator
questions.description:
An online store computes shipping in slabs: weight up to 500 g costs a flat 40 rupees; every additional STARTED 500 g block adds 15 rupees (blocks = (weight - 500 + 499) / 500 when weight > 500). Express delivery doubles the total. Invalid weights (0 or less) return -1. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int shippingCost(int weight, int express)

express is 1 for express delivery and 0 otherwise.

Input Format:
One line with the weight in grams and the express flag (0 or 1).

Output Format:
One line with the shipping cost, or -1 for invalid weights.

Constraints:
-100 <= weight <= 50000, express is 0 or 1
